title: Frontier's $209 Million Fleet Mess, United Trash-Talks Itself, and Sanctions Ground Iran's Airlines
summary: Frontier hands back two dozen jets and eats a massive charge — and it's not really about the guy they fired. Iran's airlines lose access to airports across the Middle East overnight, three separate "fume events" hit Delta and Hawaiian in one weekend, and United's CEO roasts Delta's Pacific strategy while running the exact same playbook himself.
